name: Dun Morogh
summary: In Dun Morogh, dwarves and displaced gnomes face threats from troggs, Frostmane trolls, and leper gnomes. Its guarded peaks hold Ironforge and offer shelter to both peoples.

sections.title: A Mountain Stronghold
sections.body: Dun Morogh’s high peaks rise between Searing Gorge to the south and the Wetlands to the north. Snowmelt feeds rivers across Khaz Modan, while copper and iron veins run through the mountains. Dwarven Mountaineers watch the narrow routes through North Gate Pass and South Gate Pass. At the region’s heart, Ironforge lies beneath the mountain as the capital of King Magni Bronzebeard’s realm. The Deeprun Tram links the city directly to Stormwind.

sections.title: A Refuge Divided
sections.body: Centuries ago, dwarves drove the native Frostmane ice trolls into the crags and made room for themselves beside their gnome allies. The two peoples thrived in neighboring mountain halls until Gnomeregan fell during the Third War. Troggs invaded, and radioactive gas ruined the city, turning its defenders into leper gnomes. High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque and the surviving gnomes fled into exile. They now live as guests in Ironforge, while leper gnomes and surviving troggs spill into Chill Breeze Valley.

sections.title: Trouble in the Drifts
sections.body: Trouble reaches across the mountain drifts. The Frostmane tribe has grown bolder, raising armed camps from Shimmer Ridge to Coldridge Valley. Troggs have clawed up from ancient underground fissures into Gol'Bolar Quarry, endangering the mines. Wendigos prowl, wild boars roam, Dark Iron dwarven agents infiltrate, and toxic fallout spreads from Gnomeregan’s ruins. Dwarven Mountaineers struggle to keep order from Kharanos to the border gates.

faq.q: What races start in Dun Morogh?
faq.answer: Dwarves and gnomes begin their journeys in Coldridge Valley, a sheltered basin in southwestern Dun Morogh. From there, they pass through Coldridge Pass into Kharanos and the wider zone.

During the Third War, troggs swarmed Gnomeregan from below. High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque released radioactive gas into the lower levels to purge them, but the plan failed. Thousands died, many gnomes became crazed leper gnomes, and the healthy survivors fled to Ironforge.

faq.q: How do you leave Dun Morogh on foot?
faq.answer: High mountain ridges surround Dun Morogh. To reach Loch Modan on foot, follow the roads to North Gate Pass or South Gate Pass in the northeastern mountains. From Ironforge, the Deeprun Tram carries travelers directly to Stormwind City.

faq.q: Where is the flight master in Dun Morogh?
faq.answer: The zone’s only functional Alliance flight master is inside Ironforge’s Great Forge. The flight routes connect travelers with places across Khaz Modan, Stormwind, and the northern Alliance outposts.

aliases: why are there trolls in dun morogh
faq.answer: The Frostmane are ice trolls who ruled Dun Morogh long before the dwarves emerged from Uldaman. Dwarves defeated them and drove them into the crags generations ago, but they remain bitter enemies of Ironforge and raid farms and roads from retreats such as Frostmane Hold.

Kharanos is the main dwarven settlement in central Dun Morogh. It has the Thunderbrew Distillery, trainers, and supplies, and Mountaineers and young adventurers use it as a base against local trolls and wildlife.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you come from this ancestral homeland. From Anvilmar’s hearthfires to the Great Forge’s blazing core, you defend these peaks from trolls and troggs in service to King Magni.
As a gnome, your lost home of Gnomeregan lies irradiated in the western valley. You make your base in Dun Morogh beside your dwarven cousins while fighting troggs and rogue leper gnomes.
As a miner, you can find rich surface deposits of Copper Veins in Dun Morogh, especially around Gol'Bolar Quarry and along snowy rock faces.
As a cook, you can find hearty fare in Kharanos and Brewnall Village, where hunters and innkeepers make use of boar meat, bear ribs, and dwarven stout against the mountain frost.
